description:
Lawyers join us at the Covid Litigation Conference, March 25-26 in Atlanta
"I am going to share my experience & what it took for me to get up to speed. This...is some of the most personally & professionally rewarding work I have done."
-Attorney Jeff Childers https://smartbizlaw.com/Show more Learn more & register at https://www.VacSafety.org/events
Come away with a network of civil litigators who are experienced in Covid-related lawsuits and practical skills on how to try these cases.
The Covid Litigation Conference 2023 (CLC 2023) is a unique gathering of trial lawyers advancing Covid-19-related litigation. Over the next 10 years, Covid lawsuits are projected to experience tremendous growth. The conference will offer networking opportunities and panel discussions led by attorneys engaged in Covid-19 litigation. The conference is designed for an attorney audience; however, the public is also welcome to purchase tickets. Show less
